這裡定義允許的節點類型與關係類型，並檢查資料是否符合規則。: This page defines the allowed node and relation types and checks the data against them.
名稱一律用中文，英文與其他資料放在屬性裡。: Names are Chinese; English names and other data live in attributes.
唯讀。資料規則由 GoodMind 團隊維護。: Read-only. The rules are maintained by the GoodMind team.
每家公司和商品都放在這棵樹裡。箭頭表示產業鏈：上游區隔的產出是下游的投入。: Every company and offering sits in this tree. Arrows show the value chain: one segment’s output feeds the next.
建議由共同分組推算，不是事實。接受會建立一筆標記為「推論」的紀錄；拒絕後不再出現: Suggestions are inferred from shared groups and are not facts. Accepting creates a record marked “inferred”; rejecting hides it for good.
資料是否符合規則: Does the data follow the rules
錯誤＝違反規則；待補＝資料還不完整（例如來源沒有日期），系統不會自行猜測。: Errors break a rule. Gaps are incomplete data (for example a source with no date); the system never guesses them.
要把規則和資料都還原成初始版本嗎？: Reset both the rules and the data to the initial version?

組合多個條件找出符合的公司。每家公司只出現一次，並列出符合的原因與來源。缺資料會: Combine conditions to find matching companies. Each company appears once, with the reasons and sources. Missing data is shown as “unknown”, never as “no”.
用條件找出符合的公司；結果會顯示在對話裡，圖譜只留下符合的公司。: Find companies that match conditions. Results appear in the chat and the graph keeps only those companies.

沒有符合條件的公司。這不代表市場上不存在，只是目前資料沒有符合的紀錄。: No company matches. That does not mean none exists; the data just has no matching record.

GoodMind 知識圖譜怎麼組成: How the GoodMind knowledge graph is built
「可靠度」和「目前階段」是兩件事：正式公告的 MOU 可以同時是「已驗證」與「已: Reliability and lifecycle are separate: an officially announced MOU can be both “verified” and “announced”, yet that does not mean revenue.
「同時列出」的商品、合作、競爭者只是補充，不會增加或減少符合的公司。: “Also list” items (offerings, collaborations, competitors) only add detail; they never add or remove matching companies.
不管是人工建立、接受 AI 建議，還是之後由 AI 抽取，所有資料都經過同一個入: Whether entered by hand, accepted from an AI suggestion or later extracted by AI, all data passes through one entry point. A batch is either fully accepted or fully refused with reasons.
主題、有日期的事件，以及媒體提及。提及不代表公司參與。: Topics, dated events and media mentions. A mention does not mean a company takes part.
代號（id）固定不變，不拿來顯示。: The id never changes and is not shown to readers.
來源文件 → 從中抽出的主張 → 一筆標準事實。同一筆事實可以有多份來源；互相矛: Source document → a claim taken from it → one canonical fact. A fact can have several sources; conflicting sources are kept and marked “disputed”, never silently overwritten.
供應、合作、競爭都是一筆紀錄，可以掛多方、階段與來源。: Supply, collaboration and competition are each a record that can carry several parties, a stage and sources.
全部符合＝交集、任一符合＝聯集、排除＝只排除確實有紀錄的公司。: All of = intersection, any of = union, exclude = removes only companies with an actual matching record.
兩家公司用同一種技術或在同一個產業，不會自動變成「已確認的競爭」或「已確認的合作: Two companies sharing a technology or an industry never automatically become confirmed competitors or partners. Those come only from sourced records.
公司、產品、技術、產業、合作紀錄等「東西」。: The “things”: companies, products, technologies, industries, collaboration records.
公司主要經營的領域: The field a company mainly operates in
公司，以及公司賣的產品、服務與業務。: Companies and the products, services and business lines they sell.
其他叫法與股票代號放在 aliases，用來比對是否為同一家公司。: Other names and tickers go in aliases, used to tell whether two names are the same company.
可以記錄多方、階段、範圍的合作事實: A collaboration fact with parties, stage and scope
合作或供應目前在哪個階段？: What stage is the collaboration or supply at?
同一家公司不能重複（用名稱、別名、股票代號比對）: A company cannot be duplicated (matched by name, alias and ticker)
同一家公司可以從技術、產業或應用找到；結果只算一次，但每條路徑都保留。: A company can be reached through technology, industry or application; it counts once, and every path is kept.
同產業的公司一定互相競爭: Companies in the same industry must compete
名稱一律用中文；英文與原文名稱放在屬性 name_en。: Names are always Chinese; English and original names go in the name_en attribute.
名稱要用中文（型號與來源標題除外）: Names must be Chinese (except model numbers and source titles)
屬性的 key 用英文小寫加底線，同一個意思只用一個 key。: Attribute keys are lower-case with underscores; one meaning, one key.
市場正在討論的概念: A concept the market is discussing
必填欄位要有值、型別要正確: Required fields must be filled with the right type
技術一定只有一個擁有者: A technology has exactly one owner
把公司、產品、技術、市場與事件建成可以重複使用的節點，用有方向、有來源的關係連起: Companies, products, technologies, markets and events are reusable nodes, connected by directed, sourced relations, so different conditions find the same company and explain why.
把公司串成上下游，並連到 ETF 持股。: Links companies into a value chain and to ETF holdings.
搜尋關係，例如：賣、供應、公司: Search relations, e.g. sells, supply, company
新增關係、審核 AI 建議、檢查資料品質，以及調整允許的節點與關係類型。: Add relations, review AI suggestions, check data quality and adjust the allowed node and relation types.
有共同買家與需求的市場: A market with shared buyers and needs
有方向的連結：公司「賣」產品、產品「使用」技術、合作紀錄「有參與方」。: Directed links: a company sells a product, a product uses a technology, a collaboration has participants.
每個事實都要能追到來源。: Every fact must trace back to a source.
每個節點只有四個固定欄位：代號（id）、類型（type）、中文名稱（name）和: Each node has four fixed fields: id, type, Chinese name and attributes. Everything else lives in attributes and can be extended freely.
每條關係都說明：依據哪份來源、何時有效、有多確定。: Every relation states its source, when it is valid and how certain it is.
每種關係都規定誰可以連到誰。「系統算出」的關係由紀錄推算，「AI 建議」只能接受: Each relation defines what may connect to what. Computed relations are derived from records and AI suggestions can only be accepted or rejected; neither can be created by hand.
現實中什麼時候有效？: When is it valid in the real world?
產品採用的技術或平台: A technology or platform that products use
產業 › 市場區隔 › 產品類別，加上技術與應用。: Industry › market segment › product category, plus technology and application.
研究助理的「用條件找公司」、API 和聊天機器人都使用同一種查詢格式。查詢只能走: The assistant’s “find companies by conditions”, the API and the chatbot share one query format. A query may only follow the registered paths below, so the same conditions and data always give the same result.
節點類型與關係類型必須存在: The node type and relation type must exist
系統算出與 AI 建議的關係不能手動建立: Computed and AI-suggested relations cannot be created by hand
缺資料會標示為「未知」，不會當成「沒有」。: Missing data is shown as “unknown”, never as “no”.
被提到的公司已經量產或獲利: A mentioned company is already shipping or profiting
裡面的公司賣完全一樣的產品: Companies in it sell identical products
趨勢：市場在談什麼: Trends: what the market talks about
關係兩端的節點類型與方向要正確: Endpoint types and direction must be correct
需要來源的關係一定要附來源: Relations that need a source must have one

可以用這些條件找公司，並用「全部符合／任一符合／排除」組合。每個條件只走右邊登記: Find companies with these conditions, combined with all of / any of / exclude. Each condition follows only the registered paths on the right.
新增關係、審核系統建議、檢查資料品質。: Add relations, review suggestions and check data quality.

來源是官網、公告、年報與新聞；每個事實都附來源。: Sources are official sites, filings, annual reports and news; every fact carries a source.
公司先用名稱、別名、股票代號比對，同一家公司只建一筆。: Companies are matched by name, alias and ticker first, so each exists once.
名稱一律用中文，英文與原文名稱另外保存。: Names are Chinese; English and original names are kept separately.
所有資料寫入前都檢查類型、方向、必填與來源，不合格就退回。: Every write is checked for type, direction, required fields and sources, and refused if it fails.
每個事實標示：已驗證、有報導、推論、建議或有爭議。: Each fact is marked verified, reported, inferred, suggested or disputed.
「可靠度」和「目前階段」分開：已公告的 MOU 可以是已驗證，但不代表有營收。: Reliability and lifecycle are separate: an announced MOU can be verified without meaning revenue.
互相矛盾的來源會保留並標示有爭議，不會自動覆蓋。: Conflicting sources are kept and marked disputed, never overwritten.
供應、合作、競爭都先記成一筆紀錄，再由紀錄推算出公司之間的關係。: Supply, collaboration and competition are stored as records; company-level links are derived from them.
同產業或同技術只會產生「建議」，不會自動變成已確認的競爭或合作。: Sharing an industry or technology only produces a suggestion, never a confirmed link.
建議要經人工接受，才會成為標示為「推論」的紀錄。: A suggestion becomes a record marked “inferred” only after a person accepts it.
搜尋只走登記過的路徑；同樣的條件和資料一定得到同樣的結果。: Search follows registered paths only; the same conditions and data always give the same result.
同一家公司只出現一次，並列出每條符合的路徑與來源。: Each company appears once, with every matching path and its sources.
缺資料標示為「未知」，不當成「沒有」。: Missing data is marked unknown, not treated as no.
